title: Clustering and machine learning-based integration identify cancer associated fibroblasts genes' signature in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
summary: Clustering and ML identify a cancer-associated fibroblast signature in head-and-neck cancer, with associations to prognosis, immunosuppression, HPV status and ligand-receptor signaling. This is a specific tumor-microenvironment result from transcriptomic/single-cell analyses; mechanisms remain associative.
